fields.label: Enable Visitor Analytics
fields.description: When disabled, no visitor tracking records are created. All tracking APIs return a safe no-op response.

fields.label: Privacy Mode
fields.description: Balanced: persistent anonymous visitor_id across sessions. Strict: session-only, no returning visitor history.

fields.label: Enable Persistent Visitor ID
fields.description: Store visitor_id in a first-party cookie/localStorage for returning visitor recognition. Only applies in Balanced mode.

fields.label: Visitor Cookie Expiry (Days)
fields.description: How long the anonymous visitor_id cookie persists. Default 365 days.

fields.label: Session Timeout (Minutes)
fields.description: Inactivity period after which a new session is created on next visit.

fields.label: Heartbeat Interval (Seconds)
fields.description: How often the frontend sends active-time heartbeats.

fields.label: Store Approximate Country
fields.description: Derive approximate country from request IP (IP is not stored). Requires a local GeoIP database.

fields.label: Store Approximate City
fields.description: Derive approximate city from request IP (IP is not stored). City may be inaccurate.

fields.label: GeoIP Database Path
fields.description: Absolute path to a local MaxMind GeoLite2-City.mmdb file. Leave blank to skip geo lookup. Install geoip2: pip install geoip2

fields.label: Strip Query Parameters from Page URLs
fields.description: Recommended. Prevents accidental storage of sensitive query parameters (tokens, emails, etc.).

fields.label: Allowed Query Parameters (JSON array)
fields.description: When strip_url_query_params is enabled, only these query parameters are preserved in page_url. UTM params are safe to keep.
